answer: Farming becomes a forge bet on surviving 46 epochs of grading, and every opal settlement recomputes the haven schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 13 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 46 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 11 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
